geometry.patient: Visible GLB skinned triangles captured in each arm pose, with anatomical labels from bones; fallback dummy before loading
geometry.detectors: Conservative boxes from original Symbia component vertices; finite longitudinal and tangential footprint
geometry.registration: Existing scene units and head/patient transforms

browser_checks: Protected manual approach stops with 2.5 mm clearance and contact-avoided message
Training approach reaches 10.0 mm simulated penetration with red contact point and anatomical region
Current posture includes raised forearms at oblique angles
Whole-body start rotates from 30 degrees to 0 before counts and table travel
Automatic approach and sequential table travel maintain positive patient/table clearance
Acquisition continues to accumulate both detector images and pauses without losing counts
offline_checks: Finite footprints and triangle crossings without vertices inside the detector
Head, torso, feet, raised hands and overhanging housing
Intermediate path obstruction despite clear endpoints; angle wrap
Protected stopping, training depth cap, repeated attempted advance and safe withdrawal
Table protection in both modes; automatic guard always protected
Real patient GLB with bundled Three.js and production arm transforms
Contact log deduplication, actual admitted depth and optional audio activation
Acquisition guard rejects movement before accumulating counts
Per-detector projection reuse within distance bins

performance_observations.conditions: Room and Symbia visible, bone arms-up, 256 matrix, 4000 counts/s, table speed 60 cm/min. Short UI observations at pelvis, not a controlled benchmark or GPU timing. Results vary with region and workload.

limitations: Geometric training model. Detector boxes fill curved corners and holes. Fixed patient poses and a low-poly visible mannequin, not ICRP tissue meshes. No tissue deformation, forces, injury model, calibrated safety clearance or complete scanner/room self-collision. Posture buttons check destination geometry, not an animated posture transition. Logs stay in memory for the page session.
